## Description

Add a dental journey (first visit: register, history check, tooth chart, treatment plan and estimate, consent, procedure, invoice, next-stage booking, recall) to the journeys and run it as a Playwright spec on the real stack; a pilot dentist walks it and signs off.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The dental journey passes on the real stack in English and Arabic, axe clean.
- [ ] **AC2.** A named dentist signs off, recorded in the session handoff.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
